correctness.rationale: For E=(V,B,c), E²=Kc, nondegenerate symmetric orthogonally diagonalizable B and c≠0, F(c)=λc and the homomorphism condition is B(Fu,Fv)=λ B(u,v). Composition idempotence forces λ∈{0,1}. λ=1 plus nondegeneracy gives F=id. λ=0 yields precisely projections onto totally isotropic W with c∈ker F. For odd F_q, excluding isotropic W containing c gives I_r(B)−1_{B(c,c)=0}I_{r−1}(c⊥/Kc), while the number of complements containing c is q^{r(n−r−1)}. Standard ordered-isotropic-frame counting gives the explicit product for I_r. Independently enumerated all 2×2 matrices over q=3 or 5 in three form-and-c cases and recovered the predicted ranks. No formula is asserted for q even.

originality.rationale: Brache et al. (arXiv:2103.01625) determine the bilinear-form model and quadratic types of evolution algebras with one-dimensional square. The assessed addition is a full algebra-homomorphism retract classification and labeled odd-field rank spectrum depending explicitly on isotropy of c; the older algebra classification is not claimed new. Facchini–Heidari Zadeh analyze idempotent maps in unital weakly augmented constructions, not this nonunital evolution-algebra census.
